parole.significato: dissemination, spreading, transmission (of ideas, messages, news, trends, etc.)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Koine Greek διάδοσις (diádosis, “distribution”), with -ση (-si) ending and semantic loan from German Verbreitung (von Gerüchten) and English spreading (of rumours) in the sense 'rumours'.
Learned borrowing from Ancient Greek εὕρημα (heúrēma) with semantic loan from German Befund and English findings.
